title: Decomposing Grassmann Monomials for Superfield Expansions
summary: Superspace extends spacetime by anticommuting Grassmann coordinates, whose indices may transform under spin and flavour groups. Decomposing Grassmann monomials into independent invariant structures is a central step in constructing superfield expansions, but becomes increasingly difficult in extended superspace. We present a general representation-theoretic procedure for decomposing the space $Λ^n(\mathbb{C}^{d_S}\otimes \mathbb{C}^{d_F})$, where $d_S$ and $d_F$ are the dimensions of the spin and flavour representations.
